brief.name: Rim Nam
brief.industry: A modern riverside Thai restaurant in Bangkok (Chao Phraya) — regional Thai cooking, a cocktail bar, and reservations
brief.audience: Bangkok diners 25-45 and visiting food travellers seeking contemporary Thai with a real sense of place; date nights, special occasions, weekend lunches. Thai + English.
brief.references: Modern Bangkok dining (Bo.lan, Err, Sorn), Central/EmQuartier hospitality polish, SCB-clean UI
brief.context: Bilingual Thai + English using a proper Thai webfont (Noto Sans Thai / IBM Plex Sans Thai) — Thai text must render correctly with tone/vowel marks. Hero with the riverside setting, a signature menu (with ฿ prices), chef's story, gallery, reservation CTA, and a find-us/hours footer. Calm modern base with restrained gold accents; a slim lai-thai/kranok line as a divider only.
brief.avoid: Temples + elephants + tuk-tuk clichés. Gilded ornament as wallpaper. Thai rendered in a fallback font that breaks tone marks. Festival-poster loudness. English-only.
